0.1: My lovely granddaughter, #bHard as Stone#k, will be having a birthday soon, and... Don't ask about the name. My son named her, and #rhe's no longer with us#k...
0.2: Anyway, #bI don't know what to get a girl for her birthday#k. I can't even get close enough to ask her... Could you ask her for me? She's in the #bTribal Refugee Camp#k.

yes.0: If only I could #rsee#k my #bgranddaughter#k, even just for a moment... Just head #beast#k from this town to reach the refuge.

no.0: How can you refuse an elder so easily?

1.1: I wish I could see #bgrandfather#k? I #rmiss him so much#k.

yes.0: Who else could I be?!\r\nI'm tougher than #ba rock#k, and I never cry!
